Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (CXMS) study using the DSSO linker to map the binding site of antibodies on hCD38-ECD. While the PRIDE metadata says 'No PTMs', the text explicitly lists several variable modifications including the crosslinker remnants and standard modifications. The use of MS2-MS3 strategy on an Orbitrap Fusion is characteristic of DDA-based cross-linking analysis.

scope: RP02 and 028 antibodies were crosslinked with hCD38‐ECD using CID‐cleavable crosslinker DSSO
The antibody and hCD38‐ECD were mixed in PBS and incubated for 30 min on ice.

The binary complex of hCD38‐ECD with RP02 or 028 was first crosslinked by the collision‐induced dissociation (CID)‐cleavable crosslinker disuccinimido sulfoxide (DSSO), and then digested using chymotrypsin.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on a binary complex consisting of purified recombinant hCD38 extracellular domain (hCD38-ECD) and purified scFv antibodies (RP02 or 028).
